faq_heading: Chilliwack Proper West condos and townhomes: your questions answered

faq.q: What did condos and townhomes in Chilliwack Proper West sell for?
faq.a: 38 condos sold in Chilliwack Proper West between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $318,250.

faq.q: How long do condos and townhomes take to sell in Chilliwack Proper West?
faq.a: The median was 34 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 96.1% of the last list price (8% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.

faq.q: What price range do most condos and townhomes in Chilliwack Proper West sell in?
faq.a: The middle half of the 38 condos that sold in Chilliwack Proper West went for between $276,250 and $399,500, around a median of $318,250.

faq.q: Do condos and townhomes in Chilliwack Proper West sell above asking price?
faq.a: 8% of the 38 condos sold for more than the last list price, and the median sale was 96.1% of it.

faq.q: What is a typical strata fee for condos and townhomes in Chilliwack Proper West?
faq.a: Of the 38 sales, 38 listings gave a monthly fee and the median was $403.

faq.q: How old are the condos and townhomes that sold in Chilliwack Proper West?
faq.a: The median year built was 1994 for the 38 condos sold in Chilliwack Proper West.

faq.q: How many bedrooms do condos and townhomes in Chilliwack Proper West usually have?
faq.a: The median condo that sold in Chilliwack Proper West had 2 bedrooms, from the 38 sales between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.

faq.q: Can I book a private showing with Jared?
faq.a: Yes. Jared Gibbons, REALTOR® with Royal LePage Little Oak Realty, books private showings across the Fraser Valley and Metro Vancouver. Call or text 604-928-1361, or use the contact form on this site.

What Chilliwack Proper West condos and townhomes sold for, November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026

38 condos sold in Chilliwack Proper West with a median price of $318,250 (the middle half sold between $276,250 and $399,500), taking a median of 34 days to sell at 96.1% of the last list price; 8% sold above list. They had a median $320 per square foot, a median year built of 1994 and a median strata fee of $403 a month. 18 townhomes sold in Chilliwack Proper West with a median price of $447,500 (the middle half sold between $411,750 and $600,562), taking a median of 20 days to sell at 96.5% of the last list price; 0% sold above list. They had a median $330 per square foot, a median year built of 1992 and a median strata fee of $396 a month.

blocks.text: How Chilliwack Proper West compares with the rest of Chilliwack

The median condo in Chilliwack Proper West sold for $318,250, 3% above the Chilliwack median of $310,000 across 133 sales. Chilliwack Proper West condos took a median 34 days to sell, against 36 days for Chilliwack as a whole.
